  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: llm_batch_fail_results returns reason_text without applying the 200-character cap, so fail-open reasons from llm_prompt_missing_reason can exceed the verifier's reason-length contract.
  WHY: Multiple reviewers reported the same output-bound violation; some characterize it as a minor pre-existing inconsistency, while others note it can produce overlong verified_rejections.json reasons on long workspace paths.

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- scripts/review_reject_verify.sh:llm_batch_fail_results (line ~368) | severity=low | confidence=1
  PROBLEM: Reason text from `llm_prompt_missing_reason` can exceed the 200-character cap enforced by `validate_llm_batch_output` for LLM-provided reasons.
  WHY: Apply `squish(reason_text, LLM_VERIFIER_REASON_MAX_CHARS)` inside `llm_batch_fail_results` or at the single call site that passes `llm_prompt_missing_reason`; this was described as a minor inconsistency rather than a runtime correctness issue.
=== END FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===
- scripts/review_reject_verify.sh:365-368 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The `llm_batch_fail_results` function passes `reason_text` into the artifact JSON without applying the `LLM_VERIFIER_REASON_MAX_CHARS` (200) character cap.
  WHY: Callers using `llm_prompt_missing_reason(PROMPT_TEMPLATE)` can produce reasons exceeding 200 characters on repositories with long workspace paths, creating an inconsistency with the prompt contract that requires reasons to be under 200 characters.
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_6-plus ===
- scripts/review_reject_verify.sh:llm_batch_fail_results (lines ~362-367) | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: llm_batch_fail_results returns reason_text directly without applying the LLM_VERIFIER_REASON_MAX_CHARS (200) cap, while validate_llm_batch_output applies squish(..., LLM_VERIFIER_REASON_MAX_CHARS) to LLM-provided reasons.
  WHY: Fail-open reasons bypass the 200-character cap entirely, so verified_rejections.json can contain overlong reasons for long prompt-template paths and downstream consumers expect bounded strings.
=== END FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_6-plus ===

  WHY: This creates an inconsistency with LLM-validated reasons which are capped at 200 chars; the reviewer characterized it as pre-existing and minor, but still flagged the contract inconsistency.
